# CocoCorp

> CocoCorp (cococorp.tech) is a South African technology company that helps small businesses build a professional digital presence and use AI to grow. It combines digital marketing — websites, local SEO, Google Ads, and social media management — with AI coaching for business owners and teams. Based in Midrand, Gauteng, South Africa, and serving clients worldwide.

Founded with over 10 years of enterprise data and technology experience. Communication is WhatsApp-first: +27 84 731 4960. Every new client receives a free website demo before any payment — a genuine risk-free offer. All prices are in South African Rand (ZAR) and exclude VAT.

- [Home](https://cococorp.tech/): Overview of CocoCorp's digital marketing and AI services
- [Digital Marketing](https://cococorp.tech/digital-marketing.html): Websites, SEO, Google Ads, and social media management, with transparent pricing
- [AI Coaching](https://cococorp.tech/ai.html): 1-on-1 executive and team AI training for business owners
- [Free AI Portal](https://cococorp.tech/portal.html): 12-module self-paced AI course, no sign-up required

## What we do

CocoCorp works across two core verticals:

**1. Digital Marketing & Presence**
- Website design: once-off builds from R3,500, or monthly plans from R500/month
- Local SEO setup and management
- Google Business Profile setup
- Google Ads management
- Social media management (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok): R3,000/month
- AI chatbot deployment: R1,500/month
- Professional email setup

**2. AI Coaching**
- 1-on-1 Executive AI Coaching Programme: R5,000 for 5 sessions + 1 month WhatsApp support
- Team AI Training: R2,500 per session, up to 20 participants, 1 hour, on-site or remote
- Ongoing AI Retainer: case-by-case pricing for ongoing strategic support
- Free AI Learning Portal: 12-module self-paced course at [cococorp.tech/portal.html](https://cococorp.tech/portal.html)
